content.text: The TL_net conducted a 4-day workshop designed to support faculty in examining their course design and teaching practice. Faculty formed small groups to participate in activities involving designing and redesigning their courses. This provided opportunity for faculty to learn about new innovative techniques to improve their courses and enhance student learning experiences. The workshop took place July 25-28, 2017 in Nairobi, and was facilitated by Ms Vivian Neal (Simon Fraser University's Teaching and Learning Centre, Canada) and co-facilitated by TL_net staff. Faculty from SONAM-EA who participated in this workshop included: Dr Eunice Ndirangu (Kenya), Tayreez Mushani (Kenya), Eunice Atsali (Kenya), Caroline Namukwaya (Uganda), Mary Namuguzi (Uganda), Dr Columba Mbekenga (Tanzania) and Dr Tumbwene Mwansisya (Tanzania).
